note: Statutory bonus per the Payment of Bonus Act as this tenant applies it. The wage ceilings, the band and the qualifying days are DATA; the Statutory Bonus screen reads them and shows its working.
bonus_wage_note: A month's bonus wage is the sum of the closed run's lines whose component carries this flag (basic + DA in most structures). An employee whose month's bonus wage exceeds eligibility_wage_ceiling is not eligible for that month; an eligible month counts the wage capped at calculation_wage_ceiling. Where the notified minimum wage is higher than the calculation ceiling the Act uses that instead — raise calculation_wage_ceiling here for such a tenant.
formula_note: annual bonus = sum over eligible months of min(bonus wage, calculation ceiling) x percent, for percent between min_percent and max_percent; the screen shows both ends of the band.
